references.text: Both verses reveal how offerings are distorted into idolatry and self-enrichment, which makes God's dwelling place unclean.
Both verses highlight the theme of prioritizing one's own children or personal gain over God, thereby distorting the offering into an act of immorality.
A deep contrast between the priest who 'offers' God's gift to himself (1 Sam) and the people who offer God's children to idols (Ez), both as breaches of the covenant.
